race.description: Footts Swan Hill Demolition Group Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: STUNTMAN (1) progressed nicely last time out to finish just 1.75 lengths from the winner in third over 2012m at Kilmore after being prominent at the bend. Worth noting Harry Coffey goes aboard. Tackling a more suitable race and gets blinkers, which could have been the missing ingredient. SURFY PETE (5) drops back in trip after he was well held last time in ninth over 1800m at Horsham. Has a win and three minor placings at this journey from five starts and shapes as a key contender. ASAL (7) finished tenth two runs back then did well last start but found one better over 1400m at Warrnambool, beaten only a nose. Nicely placed to feature in the finish. FROZEN TIDE (4) broke a long drought last time but it in style, so could go on with it with any luck from the draw.
